citation: Ahmed, Marzia. (2020). Maternal Health Risk [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5DP5D
metadata_discrepancy: UCI dataset metadata reports 1013 instances, but the served CSV contains 1014 rows. All 1014 rows are kept; no row is silently removed.

stage1.name: high risk rather than mid/low risk?
stage1.instructions: You are classifying a single maternal-health record described only by six routine measurements. Decide whether this record is HIGH risk or not. Answer with exactly one choice: 'high' if it is high risk, or 'other' if it is not high risk (that is, mid or low risk).

stage2.name: mid risk rather than low risk?
stage2.instructions: This maternal-health record has already been judged to be NOT high risk. Using only the six routine measurements, decide whether it is mid risk or low risk. Answer with exactly one choice: 'mid' or 'low'.

output_schema.choice: exactly one of the stage's allowed choices
output_schema.probabilities: a mapping from each allowed choice to a number in [0, 1]
